001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import java.util.Arrays;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.SetVar;
008import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.delta.ISetDeltaMonitor;
009import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.SetEventType;
010import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
011import org.chocosolver.util.objects.setDataStructures.ISetIterator;
012import org.clafer.common.Util;
013
014/**
015 *
016 * @author jimmy
017 */
018public class PropSetNotEqualC extends Propagator<SetVar> {
019
020    private final SetVar s;
021    private final ISetDeltaMonitor sD;
022    private final int[] c;
023
024    public PropSetNotEqualC(SetVar s, int[] c) {
025        super(new SetVar[]{s}, PropagatorPriority.LINEAR, true);
026        this.s = s;
027        this.sD = s.monitorDelta(this);
028        this.c = c;
029    }
030
031    @Override
032    public int getPropagationConditions(int vIdx) {
033        return SetEventType.all();
034    }
035
036    private void checkNotSame() throws ContradictionException {
037        if (s.isInstantiated()) {
038            if (s.getLB().size() == c.length) {
039                ISetIterator iter = s.getLB().iterator();
040                int i = 0;
041                while (iter.hasNext()) {
042                    if (c[i] != iter.nextInt()) {
043                        return;
044                    }
045                    i++;
046                }
047                assert i == c.length;
048                fails();
049            }
050        }
051    }
052
053    @Override
054    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
055        ISetIterator iter = s.getLB().iterator();
056        while (iter.hasNext()) {
057            int i = iter.nextInt();
058            if (!Util.in(i, c)) {
059                setPassive();
060                return;
061            }
062        }
063        for (int i : c) {
064            if (!s.getUB().contains(i)) {
065                setPassive();
066                return;
067            }
068        }
069        checkNotSame();
070        sD.startMonitoring();
071    }
072
073    @Override
074    public void propagate(int idxVarInProp, int mask) throws ContradictionException {
075        sD.forEach(this::onS1Env, SetEventType.REMOVE_FROM_ENVELOPE);
076        sD.forEach(this::onS1Ker, SetEventType.ADD_TO_KER);
077        checkNotSame();
078    }
079
080    private void onS1Env(int s1Env) throws ContradictionException {
081        if (isActive() && Util.in(s1Env, c)) {
082            setPassive();
083        }
084    }
085
086    private void onS1Ker(int s1Ker) throws ContradictionException {
087        if (isActive() && !Util.in(s1Ker, c)) {
088            setPassive();
089        }
090    }
091
092    private static boolean isEnvSubsetOf(SetVar s, int[] c) {
093        ISetIterator iter = s.getLB().iterator();
094        while (iter.hasNext()) {
095            int i = iter.nextInt();
096            if (!Util.in(i, c)) {
097                return false;
098            }
099        }
100        return true;
101    }
102
103    private static boolean isSubsetEnv(int[] c, SetVar s) {
104        for (int i : c) {
105            if (!s.getUB().contains(i)) {
106                return false;
107            }
108        }
109        return true;
110    }
111
112    @Override
113    public ESat isEntailed() {
114        if (!isEnvSubsetOf(s, c) || !isSubsetEnv(c, s)) {
115            return ESat.TRUE;
116        }
117        return s.isInstantiated() ? ESat.FALSE : ESat.UNDEFINED;
118    }
119
120    @Override
121    public String toString() {
122        return s + " != " + Arrays.toString(c);
123    }
124}
